subject: general
question: Who among the following won the Arjuna Award 2021 in the Fencing discipline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavani Devi Chadalavada Anandha Sundhararaman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Union Sports Minister Anurag Thakur** conferred fencer **Chadalavada Anandha Sundhararaman Bhavani Devi or CA Bhavani Devi with Arjuna Award 2021.**
 
• CA Bhavani Devi was conferred with Arjuna Award for her exemplary donation to fencing and representing India at the global position.
 
• **She was India's only entry into fencing at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chingakham Jetlee Singh:**

 
 
• Practitioner Nanak Dev University’s Chingakham Jetlee Singh lived up to his billing in the men’s epee, beating his teammate Shubham to strike gold in the fencing competition at the **Khelo India University Games (KIUG) 2021.**
 
• Jetlee, a covers athlete, was one of four GNDU medallists the most by any – in fencing.
 
 
 
• **Kavita Devi:**
 
 
• Kavita Dalal, better known as Kavita Devi, is a professional wrestler and a **former weightlifter,** who had represented India in several international competitions.
 
• Kavita Devi became the first female Wrestler from India to compete in the World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) ring.
 
 
 
• **Jyotika Dutta:**
 
 
• Rising fencing sensation Jyotika Dutta bagged the** gold order in the women's individual épée competition** by defeating Manipur University's Linthoi Haobam in the final. 22- time-old Dutta is an épée specialist.
 
• She represented India at the 2018 Asiad and managed to reach the quarterfinals in the women's individual épée at the Games in Jakarta.
